note: R660. The rules M01 to M15 as Bader approved them on 28 Oct 2026, each text word for word as the rule value, source rule, a person confirms each for a project. They name the unit types and values of that one manual, so a person on another project must check they fit. A template is read only, a project takes a copy by rulesSetup, the values are copied here so no run reads the rules profile.

rules.name: How units attach by type
rules.value: Villas and VD units detached. DP and DT semi-attached. TH attached both sides, always in pairs

rules.name: Clusters allowed
rules.value: Only the 11 Phase 1 clusters are allowed

rules.name: Units in a block and the expansion joint
rules.value: A block has at most 4 units. A 6-unit block takes an expansion joint at the 4th unit

rules.name: FFL per cluster and where a split falls
rules.value: One FFL per cluster. A split is after unit 2 or 3, with a construction joint and a double wall

rules.name: Front yard slope
rules.value: Front yard has one slope, parallel to the road, 0.5% to 2%

rules.name: Back yard slope
rules.value: Back yard graded to the front at 0.3% to 0.5%

rules.name: Townhouse back yard slope
rules.value: Townhouse back yard at 2% to a soakaway trench along the back boundary

rules.name: Added steps and step heights
rules.value: At most 3 added steps. Step heights 100, 200, 270, 370, 440, 540 mm

rules.name: Riser height limits
rules.value: Riser at least 100 mm, at most 180 mm

rules.name: Unit types with a set step count
rules.value: C10, VL4 and VL6 always have 1 step

rules.name: Boundary wall top
rules.value: Boundary wall top at FFL + 1.70 m, kept level while FFL steps stay under 0.50 m

rules.name: Garden wall top
rules.value: Garden wall top at FFL + 1.70 m

rules.name: Walls of irregular plots
rules.value: Irregular plots: boundary wall 200 mm inside the plot limit, garden wall extends 2.0 m

rules.name: Foundation depth
rules.value: Foundation at least 1.20 m below existing ground
